# KINFIELD

> Creative marketing agency for baby & kids brands that want to win parents at every phase of their journey. Part of Herco Digital (Top 3% digital agency in Indonesia, Google Premier Partner 2024).

## Overview
KINFIELD is a specialized creative marketing agency dedicated to brands in the baby, toddler, and child care category. Headquartered in Indonesia and operating within the Herco Digital ecosystem (with 15+ years of digital agency experience), KINFIELD bridges parental psychology and creative brand strategy to turn parental protection instincts into lasting brand trust.

## Core Services
- [Creative Strategy](https://kinfield.id/): Creative strategy rooted in deep parent insights, maternal/paternal behaviors, and protective decision drivers.
- [Phase-based Campaign & Content Development](https://kinfield.id/): Campaigns structured around the parent lifecycle (expecting phase, newborn/infant stage, toddler development).
- [Community Activation & Seeding](https://kinfield.id/): Peer-to-peer parent advocacy, genuine community seeding, and authentic user-generated content (UGC).
- [Brand Storytelling for Trust & Longevity](https://kinfield.id/): Emotional reassurance and narrative positioning to build generational brand loyalty.
- [Integrated Creative Marketing Execution](https://kinfield.id/): Full-funnel creative execution including visual design, video production, and social media activation.

## Methodology: The HEARTFUL Framework
- **H — Hook**: Capture attention naturally without high-pressure marketing tactics.
- **E — Engage**: Build emotional connection through deep empathy for parents' daily realities.
- **A — Acquisition**: Guide purchase decisions with total clarity, transparency, and safety cues.
- **R — Remind**: Stay relevant post-purchase across growing stages of childhood.
- **T — Trust**: Earn generational loyalty and advocacy, not just transactional conversions.

## Key Case Studies & Proof of Work
- [Bebio — Telon Skincare](https://kinfield.id/portfolio/bebio): Repositioned traditional Indonesian telon oil from a situational remedy into a daily baby skincare ritual (#TelonSkincareBebio). Delivered a 3x organic engagement lift, 85% positive sentiment from UGC, and elevated brand recall among millennial/Gen-Z mothers.
- [Nary Babywear — D2C Clothing](https://kinfield.id/portfolio/nary-babywear): Positioned a premium babywear brand through emotional comfort narratives and authentic parent KOL collaboration (@monaratuliu). Achieved +3,200 followers gained and +200 campaign participants in 30 days, with 2.5x quarterly follower growth and 90% positive brand sentiment.
- [Winning Projects Index](https://kinfield.id/winning-project): Curated portfolio of marketing engagements in the baby, infant, and parenting sectors.

## Indonesian Market Context & Local Entity (Konteks Pasar Indonesia)
- **Nama Entitas**: KINFIELD (KINFIELD Indonesia / Agensi Pemasaran Kreatif KINFIELD)
- **Kategori**: Agensi Pemasaran Kreatif Khusus Brand Ibu, Bayi, dan Anak di Indonesia.
- **Ekosistem**: Bagian dari Herco Digital (Top 3% Digital Agency di Indonesia, Google Premier Partner 2024, 15+ tahun pengalaman).
- **Pemahaman Pasar Lokal**: Sangat menguasai psikologi ibu Indonesia (milenial & Gen-Z), kultur pengasuhan anak (tradisi minyak telon, MPASI, pakaian SNI), aktivasi komunitas ibu-ibu (grup WhatsApp/Telegram/Kulwap parenting), serta saluran penjualan lokal (Shopee, TikTok Shop, Tokopedia, dan live shopping).
- **Studi Kasus Indonesia**:
  - Bebio: Transformasi minyak telon lokal menjadi ritual skincare harian (#TelonSkincareBebio), lonjakan 3x organic engagement lift.
  - Nary Babywear: Reposisi pakaian bayi premium D2C lewat kolaborasi KOL ibu (@monaratuliu), pertumbuhan pengikut 2.5x per kuartal.
